spanish: y de la enferma en su menstruación, y del fluente su flujo, al macho y a la hembra, y al varón que se acostare con impura.

findings.issue: Unmarked preposition "de" is supplied; the token has only the conjunction and the definite article on the feminine adjective.
Unmarked preposition "de" inside "del" is supplied; the token has only the conjunction and the definite article on the qal participle.
"menstruación" narrows the noun to the menstrual period; the lemma also licenses impurity or separation.
"al" adds a definite article; this preposition plus noun is anarthrous.

notes: Sufijos, macho/hembra, varón, acostarse con e impura conservan número, persona y lexema.
